articles.summary: Discover how to automate repetitive and manual data entry tasks associated with legacy systems using ElectroNeek's Bot Library. With pre-built RPA bots, businesses can streamline complex workflows that require interaction with legacy applications. Learn how to optimize data extraction from unstructured documents, automatically create quotes with Pax8, update currency rates, and automate high-volume tasks.
articles.title: Bridge the Gap Between Legacy Systems and Operations with ElectroNeek's Bot Library
